user.title: Connect to BragerOne
user.description: Sign in with the account you use on one.brager.pl or in the BragerOne app.

data_description.email: The email address of your BragerOne account.
data_description.password: The password of your BragerOne account. It is stored in Home Assistant and used to renew the session.

module.title: Choose a module
module.description: Your account has more than one module. Choose the one to add; you can add the others afterwards.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to BragerOne again
reauth_confirm.description: BragerOne no longer accepts the stored password for {email}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The current password of your BragerOne account.

data_description.email: The email address of the BragerOne account that has access to this module.

error.invalid_auth: BragerOne rejected the email address or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BragerOne. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: Every module of this account has already been added.
abort.module_missing: This account has no access to the module of this entry.

update_failed.message: Could not read the stove from BragerOne: {error}

module_not_found.message: Module {devid} is no longer in this BragerOne account.

command_failed.message: BragerOne did not accept the command: {error}

out_of_range.message: {value} is outside the range the controller accepts ({min} to {max}).

active_alarm.title: {name} reports an alarm
active_alarm.description:
The stove reports: {alarms}.

Check the stove and clear the alarm on the controller or in the BragerOne app. This message disappears when the alarm is gone.
